payload.text: ST0092 WP-04 rulings (vc, 2026-11-11): retirement is WbNode.retired: Option<WbRetired { at, reason }> in board 4.1 (folded, one shape for 3.3.0), never a status value; store rung 34 to 35. A re-apply reinstates nothing as it retires nothing: a retired declared seat shows as 'retired <m> (<reason>)' and comes back only through wb register (WP-09's doctor names it, shown not counted; cc told). The human seat has one home, seat::human_seat (declared human, else model::HYPERVISOR, no install read), which WP-06 rebases onto. The red is a door file (intent-cli tests/wb_retire_door.rs) red at runtime on the base, with wb_retire.rs as the precise half. surface_check.sh's INV-09/10/11 refusal predates WP-04 and goes to ic's WP-10.
